hotels.description: Get ready to unwind at a stunning golf retreat nestled along Victoria’s iconic Bellarine Peninsula. This exceptional Barwon Heads hideaway offers an unparalleled experience for golf enthusiasts, featuring two award-winning courses maintained to the highest standards year-round. For those seeking adventure, the nearby Thirteenth Beach offers fantastic surf conditions, or you can simply relax with a serene sunset walk along the shore. Home to the prestigious Vic Open and located just moments from pristine beaches, this retreat provides the perfect setting to practice your swing and enjoy breathtaking coastal views. When you're not on the course, indulge in gourmet dining at the modern clubhouse restaurant, where you can savour delicious meals while overlooking the expansive Beach Course.
